# 2 Chronicles Chapter 20 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-was after this came sons-of Moab and-sons-of Ammon and-with-them from the-Ammonites against Jehoshaphat for-battle.

**2** And-they-came and-they-told to-Jehoshaphat saying coming against-you a-multitude great from-beyond the-sea from-Aram and-behold-them in-Hazazon-tamar it is En-gedi.

**3** And-he-was-afraid and-he-set Jehoshaphat his-face to-seek YHWH and-he-proclaimed a-fast over all Judah.

**4** And-they-gathered Judah to-seek from-YHWH also from-all cities-of Judah they-came to-seek YHWH.

**5** And-he-stood Jehoshaphat in-assembly-of Judah and-Jerusalem in-house-of YHWH before the-court the-new.

**6** And-he-said YHWH God-of our-fathers are-not You He God in-the-heavens and-You ruling in-all kingdoms-of the-nations and-in-Your-hand is-power and-might and-none with-You to-withstand.

**7** Are-not You our-God You-dispossessed inhabitants-of this land from-before Your-people Israel and-You-gave-it to-seed-of Abraham Your-friend forever.

**8** And-they-dwelt in-it and-they-built for-You in-it a-sanctuary for-Your-name saying

**9** if comes upon-us evil sword judgment and-pestilence and-famine we-will-stand before this house and-before-You for Your-name is-in this house and-we-will-cry to-You from-our-distress and-You-will-hear and-You-will-save.

**10** And-now behold sons-of Ammon and-Moab and-Mount Seir whom not You-gave Israel to-come-into when-they-came from-land-of Egypt for they-turned from-upon-them and-not they-destroyed-them

**11** and-behold they are-repaying us to-come to-drive-us-out from-Your-possession that You-gave-us-to-possess.

**12** Our-God will-not You-judge against-them for there-is-no in-us strength before this multitude the-great this-one coming against-us and-we not we-know what we-shall-do for upon-You are our-eyes.

**13** And-all Judah were-standing before YHWH also their-little-ones their-wives and-their-sons.

**14** And-Jahaziel son-of Zechariah son-of Benaiah son-of Jeiel son-of Mattaniah the-Levite from-sons-of Asaph was upon-him spirit-of YHWH in-midst-of the-assembly.

**15** And-he-said attend all Judah and-inhabitants-of Jerusalem and-the-king Jehoshaphat thus says YHWH to-you you do-not fear and-do-not be-dismayed from-before this multitude the-great for not to-you is-the-battle but to-God.

**16** Tomorrow go-down against-them behold-them coming-up by-ascent-of the-Ziz and-you-shall-find-them at-end-of the-valley on-face-of wilderness-of Jeruel.

**17** Not to-you to-fight in-this station-yourselves stand and-see salvation-of YHWH with-you Judah and-Jerusalem do-not fear and-do-not be-dismayed tomorrow go-out before-them and-YHWH is-with-you.

**18** And-he-bowed Jehoshaphat face to-the-ground and-all Judah and-inhabitants-of Jerusalem fell before YHWH to-worship to-YHWH.

**19** And-they-stood the-Levites from-sons-of the-Kohathites and-from-sons-of the-Korahites to-praise YHWH God-of Israel with-a-voice great to-upward.

**20** And-they-rose-early in-the-morning and-they-went-out to-wilderness-of Tekoa and-as-they-went-out Jehoshaphat stood and-he-said hear-me Judah and-inhabitants-of Jerusalem believe in-YHWH your-God and-you-will-be-confirmed believe in-His-prophets and-you-will-prosper.

**21** And-he-counseled with the-people and-he-appointed singers to-YHWH and-praisers in-splendor-of holiness as-they-went-out before the-armed-ones and-saying give-thanks to-YHWH for forever His-lovingkindness.

**22** And-at-time they-began with-the-singing and-the-praise He-set YHWH ambushes against sons-of Ammon Moab and-Mount Seir the-coming against-Judah and-they-were-struck.

**23** And-they-rose-up sons-of Ammon and-Moab against inhabitants-of Mount Seir to-devote-to-destruction and-to-destroy and-as-they-finished with-inhabitants-of Seir they-helped each-man against-his-neighbor for-destruction.

**24** And-Judah came to the-watchtower to-the-wilderness and-they-looked to the-multitude and-behold-them corpses fallen to-the-ground and-none had-escaped.

**25** And-he-came Jehoshaphat and-his-people to-plunder their-spoil and-they-found among-them in-abundance and-goods and-corpses and-vessels-of desirable-things and-they-stripped for-themselves until-none carrying and-they-were three days plundering the-spoil for much it was.

**26** And-in-the-day the-fourth they-assembled in-valley-of Beracah for there they-blessed YHWH therefore they-called the-name-of the-place that valley-of Beracah to this day.

**27** And-they-returned every man-of Judah and-Jerusalem and-Jehoshaphat at-their-head to-return to-Jerusalem with-joy for He-gave-them-joy YHWH from-their-enemies.

**28** And-they-came to-Jerusalem with-harps and-with-lyres and-with-trumpets to house-of YHWH.

**29** And-was fear-of God on all kingdoms-of the-lands when-they-heard that fought YHWH against enemies-of Israel.

**30** And-was-quiet kingdom-of Jehoshaphat and-He-gave-rest to-him his-God from-all-around.

**31** And-he-reigned Jehoshaphat over Judah son-of thirty-and-five years in-his-reigning and-twenty-and-five years he-reigned in-Jerusalem and-name-of his-mother was-Azubah daughter-of Shilhi.

**32** And-he-walked in-way-of Asa his-father and-not he-turned from-it to-do the-right in-eyes-of YHWH.

**33** Only the-high-places not were-removed and-still the-people not had-fixed their-heart to-God-of their-fathers.

**34** And-rest-of acts-of Jehoshaphat the-first and-the-last behold-them written in-words-of Jehu son-of Hanani that is-taken-up in-book-of kings-of Israel.

**35** And-after this he-joined Jehoshaphat king-of Judah with Ahaziah king-of Israel he acting wickedly.

**36** And-he-joined-him with-him to-make ships to-go to-Tarshish and-they-made ships in-Ezion-geber.

**37** And-he-prophesied Eliezer son-of Dodavahu from-Mareshah against Jehoshaphat saying because-you-joined with-Ahaziah He-has-broken YHWH your-works and-they-were-broken the-ships and-not they-were-able to-go to-Tarshish.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **20:6-7**: Abraham Your-friend — Hebrew 'ohavekha, literally 'Your beloved.' Abraham is called God's friend only here and in Isaiah 41:8 in the Hebrew Bible.

- **20:12**: upon-You are our-eyes — The prayer's climactic confession: complete helplessness turning into complete dependence. This is the Chronicler's model prayer for crisis.

- **20:15**: not to-you is-the-battle but to-God — The oracle that redefines warfare: Israel's role is not to fight but to witness God's victory.

- **20:22**: as-they-began with-the-singing — Worship triggers divine intervention. The battle is won by praise, not by swords.


— EMET
